description: This file defines the class BareHtmlPageRenderer, which implements rendering of bare HTML pages in Drupal, including attaching libraries, meta tags, favicon, and processing attachments.

classes.name: BareHtmlPageRenderer
classes.description: Default implementation of a bare HTML page renderer in Drupal, responsible for rendering pages with attachments, meta tags, and libraries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing renderer, attachment processor, and theme settings provider services.

methods.name: renderBarePage
methods.description: Renders a bare HTML page with given content, title, theme property, and additional page elements, then processes attachments.

methods.name: systemPageAttachments
methods.description: Attaches necessary libraries, favicon, meta tags, and other elements to the page array for rendering.
